topic: Control horizontal and vertical movement, control of RPM, torque reaction, tail rotor compensations, contra rotating rotors.
syllabus_extract: Control horizontal and vertical movement, control of RPM, torque reaction, tail rotor compensations, contra rotating rotors.
specific_objectives: 13.1.1.1 Trainee will be able to explain the helicopter control, main rotor movements, translation flight, power, auto rotation, vibration checks and various adjustments.

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list

practical: Review of flight control stick positions and cyclic/collective inputs on simulator or ground station; Instructor supervision required for safety.
intro_questions: What is the primary function of the cyclic pitch control?
How does the collective pitch control affect the main rotor?
What is the immediate effect of torque reaction on the helicopter fuselage?

topics: RPM control via collective and throttle
development.content:
Cyclic control for horizontal movement
Collective control for vertical movement
RPM control via collective and throttle
Torque reaction and anti-torque systems
Tail rotor compensation mechanisms

topics: Comparison with single main rotor designs

Contra-rotating rotor configurations

Elimination of tail rotor requirements

Vibration checks during flight

Impact of torque on stability

Tail rotor effectiveness verification

summary_questions: Explain how the tail rotor compensates for torque reaction.
Describe the role of contra-rotating rotors in eliminating torque effects.
What steps are taken to check for vibration during flight?
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief note on the differences between single main rotor and contra-rotating rotor systems, referencing LP 02 concepts on rotor dynamics.
